attestations.note: Neither the day page nor name page 14807 carries a life. The name page lists a second day, «7 июня (прославление)», the day of his glorification; it is recorded here and the folder does not render on it. The name page also links an article on the portal, which is magazine writing and not the calendar, and was not read. The day page prints no hymn at all.
